project.description: Enables or disables Explore Without Login while preserving the existing Discover configuration. Shared anonymous access remains enabled when either feature is active. DISABLE_PUBLIC_ACCESS revokes Explore Without Login on its own, backend and UI, without touching Discover or the gateway.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: ENABLE_EXPLORE_WITHOUT_LOGIN
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Allow anonymous users to use Explorer against the authenticated HPDS backend.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: DISABLE_PUBLIC_ACCESS
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Revoke Explore Without Login: closes the authenticated HPDS backend to anonymous callers (ENABLE_PUBLIC_ACCESS=false) and takes the Explorer out of the UI (VITE_OPEN_EXPLORER=false). Discover, shared anonymous access, the gateway, and the open IDP provider are left alone. The UI half needs a frontend rebuild, so prefer the Pipeline job. Cannot be combined with Explore Without Login.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: CONFIRM_AUTH_HPDS_PUBLIC
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: I understand that Explore Without Login makes authenticated HPDS data publicly accessible.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
ENABLE_EXPLORE_WITHOUT_LOGIN="${ENABLE_EXPLORE_WITHOUT_LOGIN:-false}" CONFIRM_AUTH_HPDS_PUBLIC="${CONFIRM_AUTH_HPDS_PUBLIC:-false}" DISABLE_PUBLIC_ACCESS="${DISABLE_PUBLIC_ACCESS:-false}"
if [ "$ENABLE_EXPLORE_WITHOUT_LOGIN" = "true" ] && [ "$CONFIRM_AUTH_HPDS_PUBLIC" != "true" ]; then echo "ERROR: CONFIRM_AUTH_HPDS_PUBLIC must be true when ENABLE_EXPLORE_WITHOUT_LOGIN=true." exit 1 fi
if [ "$ENABLE_EXPLORE_WITHOUT_LOGIN" = "true" ] && [ "$DISABLE_PUBLIC_ACCESS" = "true" ]; then echo "ERROR: DISABLE_PUBLIC_ACCESS revokes the anonymous access ENABLE_EXPLORE_WITHOUT_LOGIN grants." echo "ERROR: Pick one. To turn Explore Without Login off entirely, leave both unchecked." exit 1 fi
# This shell runs inside the Jenkins container. DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR is the host # path used by sibling Docker containers, while this bind mount is always here. CONFIG_DIR="/usr/local/docker-config" HTTPD_ENV="$CONFIG_DIR/httpd/httpd.env" PSAMA_ENV="$CONFIG_DIR/psama/psama.env" GATEWAY_ENV="$CONFIG_DIR/gateway/gateway.env"
require_file() { if [ ! -f "$1" ]; then echo "ERROR: Required configuration file not found: $1" exit 1 fi }
upsert_env() { local key=$1 local value=$2 local env_file=$3 local temp_file="${env_file}.tmp.$$"
awk -v key="$key" -v value="$value" ' BEGIN { found = 0 } index($0, key "=") == 1 { if (!found) print key "=" value found = 1 next } { print } END { if (!found) print key "=" value } ' "$env_file" > "$temp_file" cat "$temp_file" > "$env_file" rm "$temp_file" }
read_env() { local key=$1 local env_file=$2 sed -n "s/^${key}=//p" "$env_file" }
validate_env() { local key=$1 local expected=$2 local env_file=$3 local actual actual="$(read_env "$key" "$env_file")" if [ "$actual" != "$expected" ]; then echo "ERROR: $env_file contains $key=$actual; expected $key=$expected." exit 1 fi }
if [ "$DISABLE_PUBLIC_ACCESS" = "true" ]; then require_file "$PSAMA_ENV" require_file "$HTTPD_ENV"
upsert_env ENABLE_PUBLIC_ACCESS false "$PSAMA_ENV" upsert_env VITE_OPEN_EXPLORER false "$HTTPD_ENV" validate_env ENABLE_PUBLIC_ACCESS false "$PSAMA_ENV" validate_env VITE_OPEN_EXPLORER false "$HTTPD_ENV"
echo "Anonymous access to authenticated HPDS (ENABLE_PUBLIC_ACCESS): false" echo "Explorer offered to anonymous users (VITE_OPEN_EXPLORER): false" echo "Discover, shared anonymous access, gateway open access, and the open IDP provider" echo "were left as they are. VITE_OPEN stays set, so a Discover-only stack keeps working." echo "PSAMA reads ENABLE_PUBLIC_ACCESS at startup; run Start PIC-SURE to apply it." echo "VITE_OPEN_EXPLORER is baked into the frontend bundle at build time, so the UI keeps" echo "offering Explore Without Login until PIC-SURE Frontend Build runs. Use Enable Explore" echo "Without Login Pipeline to get the rebuild and the restart together." exit 0 fi
require_file "$HTTPD_ENV" require_file "$PSAMA_ENV" require_file "$GATEWAY_ENV"
DISCOVER_ENABLED="$(read_env VITE_DISCOVER "$HTTPD_ENV")" DISCOVER_ENABLED="${DISCOVER_ENABLED:-false}" if [ "$DISCOVER_ENABLED" != "true" ] && [ "$DISCOVER_ENABLED" != "false" ]; then echo "ERROR: $HTTPD_ENV contains invalid VITE_DISCOVER=$DISCOVER_ENABLED." exit 1 fi
if [ "$DISCOVER_ENABLED" = "true" ] || [ "$ENABLE_EXPLORE_WITHOUT_LOGIN" = "true" ]; then ENABLE_ANONYMOUS_REQUESTS=true else ENABLE_ANONYMOUS_REQUESTS=false fi
upsert_env VITE_OPEN "$ENABLE_ANONYMOUS_REQUESTS" "$HTTPD_ENV" upsert_env VITE_OPEN_EXPLORER "$ENABLE_EXPLORE_WITHOUT_LOGIN" "$HTTPD_ENV" upsert_env OPEN_IDP_PROVIDER_IS_ENABLED "$ENABLE_ANONYMOUS_REQUESTS" "$PSAMA_ENV" upsert_env ENABLE_PUBLIC_ACCESS "$ENABLE_EXPLORE_WITHOUT_LOGIN" "$PSAMA_ENV" upsert_env GATEWAY_OPEN_ACCESS_ENABLED "$ENABLE_ANONYMOUS_REQUESTS" "$GATEWAY_ENV"
validate_env VITE_OPEN "$ENABLE_ANONYMOUS_REQUESTS" "$HTTPD_ENV" validate_env VITE_OPEN_EXPLORER "$ENABLE_EXPLORE_WITHOUT_LOGIN" "$HTTPD_ENV" validate_env OPEN_IDP_PROVIDER_IS_ENABLED "$ENABLE_ANONYMOUS_REQUESTS" "$PSAMA_ENV" validate_env ENABLE_PUBLIC_ACCESS "$ENABLE_EXPLORE_WITHOUT_LOGIN" "$PSAMA_ENV" validate_env GATEWAY_OPEN_ACCESS_ENABLED "$ENABLE_ANONYMOUS_REQUESTS" "$GATEWAY_ENV"
echo "Existing Open Access/Discover: $DISCOVER_ENABLED" echo "Explore Without Login: $ENABLE_EXPLORE_WITHOUT_LOGIN" echo "Anonymous requests: $ENABLE_ANONYMOUS_REQUESTS" echo "Anonymous access to authenticated HPDS (ENABLE_PUBLIC_ACCESS): $ENABLE_EXPLORE_WITHOUT_LOGIN" echo "Configuration written and validated."
